# Kamil Salameh Photography

> Kamil Salameh is a Lebanese photographer specializing in landscape photography, astrophotography, architectural and street photography, and fine art. He is the founder of Kamil Salameh Photography, a fine art photography studio based in Lebanon that sells fine art prints and photo gifts and accepts commercial, architectural and private photography commissions.

Key facts:

- Name: Kamil Salameh (photographer). Studio: Kamil Salameh Photography.
- Website: https://kamilsalamehphotography.com
- Based in: Lebanon. His Lebanese work includes Kfardebian in Mount Lebanon (the Roman temple ruins of Faqra, a natural rock bridge, Milky Way astrophotography), the Bekaa Valley, and the statue of Saint Charbel in Faraya.
- Places in the portfolio include Paris (Sacré-Cœur), the Zaanse Schans windmills in Zaandam, Saarburg, Oslo, Nyhavn in Copenhagen, Stockholm, Dinant, İstiklal Avenue in Istanbul, the Grund in Luxembourg, Yerevan with Mount Ararat, and the Masai Mara.
- Specialties: landscape, astrophotography, architecture, street, fine art and product photography.
- Countries in the portfolio: Lebanon, France, Belgium, the Netherlands, Luxembourg, Germany, Denmark, Sweden, Norway, Turkey, Armenia and Kenya.
- Tools: Canon cameras, Adobe Lightroom.
- Offers: fine art prints and canvas (A5 to A0, framed or unframed), wooden desk frames, coaster sets, collector puzzles, bespoke memory books, commercial and architectural photography, private photography sessions. Each request receives a personal quote; within Lebanon, payment is cash on delivery.
- Expertise beyond photography: leadership, business development and consultancy, AI automation, process and workflow optimization, and mentorship.
- Profiles: Instagram https://instagram.com/kamilsalameh · LinkedIn (personal) https://lb.linkedin.com/in/kamilsalameh · LinkedIn (Kamil Salameh Photography) https://www.linkedin.com/company/kamilsalamehphotography/ · 35AWARDS https://35awards.com/en/author/salamehkamil/
- Contact: contact form at https://kamilsalamehphotography.com/#contact or Instagram direct message @kamilsalameh.
- Copyright: all photographs © Kamil Salameh; no reproduction or AI training use without written permission. Licensing on request.
